description: Stock-scan rule book for the swing 'Scan stocks' option. Each rule is a single, well-defined screen the user can pick: it walks the stock universe (or the current sector), and for every stock checks whether the live price is currently sitting INSIDE a price zone of a given kind. The four kinds are: a CONFIRMED demand zone, a FORMING demand zone, a FORMING supply zone, and a CONFIRMED supply zone. Demand = a floor where buyers stepped in (bullish, a potential long entry). Supply = a ceiling where sellers stepped in (bearish, a place to AVOID buying / watch for rejection). 'Forming' = marked the instant a base candle closed, BEFORE a confirming move proved it — lower trust than confirmed (real money: a forming zone never backs a full-size BUY on its own). This file is a declarative SPEC consumed at runtime by scripts/swing-analyzer.js; the actual matching logic lives there.

engine.comment: Zones are read off CONFIRMED (closed) daily candles only — never the live forming bar (no repainting). The universe scan already fetches each stock's daily candles, so the zone detectors run on that same data with no extra API calls.

priceInside.definition: A stock matches when its current price lies within the zone band, i.e. min(proximal, distal) - buffer <= price <= max(proximal, distal) + buffer. The proximal/distal orientation differs by zone type (see zoneGeometry), but the min/max form below is orientation-agnostic and is what implementation should use.
priceInside.edgeBufferComment: Small outward tolerance (0.15x the 14-period ATR) so a price hugging or just lifting off an edge still counts as 'inside' rather than being missed by a rounding-thin miss. Set to 0 for a strict inside-only match.

zoneGeometry.DEMAND: proximal = the UPPER edge (nearer the price, which approaches from above); distal = the LOWER edge (the deeper floor / stop side).
zoneGeometry.SUPPLY: proximal = the LOWER edge (nearer the price, which approaches from below); distal = the UPPER edge (the higher ceiling / stop side).

confirmed.note: BROKEN zones (price later closed through them) are already dropped by the detector, so any zone returned is alive.

forming.note: Forming DEMAND is implemented today. Forming SUPPLY is NOT yet detected — rule 'price-in-forming-supply' is blocked on adding a mirrored bearish detector (a 'detectFormingZones' supply side: a bearish turn candle — shooting star / bearish-engulfing / long upper-wick rejection — at the top of a tight base after a rally up into the level). Build that before enabling rule #3.

displayFilter.comment: For forming zones, reuse this trim so a scan match is RECENT (formed within ~40 bars), UNBROKEN (price has not since closed past the distal edge), and not a duplicate of a confirmed zone.

IN_DEMAND.meaning: Price is inside a confirmed demand floor — a potential long entry pending the usual gates (trend, R:R, freshness).

IN_FORMING_DEMAND.meaning: Price is inside a still-forming demand floor — EARLY watch only, small-starter at most, never a full-size BUY.

IN_FORMING_SUPPLY.meaning: Price is inside a still-forming supply ceiling — early warning of overhead selling; do not chase longs here.

IN_SUPPLY.meaning: Price is inside a confirmed supply ceiling — strong overhead resistance; AVOID buying, watch for rejection.

rules.label: Price inside demand zone

filters.maxTouchesComment: CHART PARITY (trust-critical): the chart RETIRES any zone with 2+ distinct re-entries (touches), so a scanned match must have touches <= 1 — otherwise the row says 'In Demand' but the chart draws no zone at price. 'touches' is the per-VISIT count; the per-bar 'testCount' below over-counts a fresh multi-candle base as 'tested 2x', so touches is the right gate.
filters.maxTestCountComment: Secondary, looser cap on the per-bar in-band count. Reject worn-out floors; the real worn-out gate is maxTouches.

rules.meaning: Stocks whose price is currently resting inside a confirmed demand zone — the classic 'pulled back into the floor' swing buy location.
rules.action: Shortlist for a long. This is a LOCATION match only — confirm the higher-timeframe trend, a reversal trigger candle, and R:R before entering.
rules.caveat: Being inside a demand zone is necessary, not sufficient. A demand zone in a downtrend, or with poor R:R, is still a WAIT.

rules.label: Price inside forming demand zone
rules.meaning: Stocks sitting inside a demand zone that has only just formed (no confirming rally yet) — the earliest, quietest look at a base before it moves.
rules.action: EARLY watchlist. At most a small, tight-stopped starter (stop just below the zone distal, 2R+ target); add full size only if the zone later CONFIRMS.
rules.caveat: Backtest reality: forming demand reversals win only ~40% of the time (+0.2R at 2R). Honest label — this is NOT a high-conviction BUY list.

rules.deferredNote: Deferred by user (2026-06-11): ship the two demand BUY-setup rules first; supply rules come later. Also still blocked on the forming-supply detector below.
rules.blockedBy: detectFormingZones currently produces DEMAND only; a mirrored forming-SUPPLY detector must be added first (see engine.detectors.forming.note).
rules.label: Price inside forming supply zone
rules.meaning: Stocks sitting inside a supply zone that has only just formed — an early warning that sellers may be building a ceiling here.
rules.action: Do NOT buy into this. For a long-only book this is an AVOID / wait-for-breakout flag; for a short idea it is an EARLY watch only.
rules.caveat: Forming = unproven. Same low-trust honesty as forming demand — never act with size on a forming flag alone.

rules.deferredNote: Deferred by user (2026-06-11): the detector is ready, but we ship the two demand BUY-setup rules first and add the supply (avoid/short-watch) rules in a later pass.
rules.label: Price inside supply zone

filters.maxTouchesComment: Chart parity — same as price-in-demand: only zones the chart still draws (touches <= 1).

rules.meaning: Stocks whose price has risen into a confirmed supply zone — directly under overhead resistance.
rules.action: AVOID buying here. Useful as a 'do-not-chase' guard, a place to book longs into strength, or a short-watch (subject to its own gates).
rules.caveat: A long signal that fires while price is inside confirmed supply is a contradiction — this rule helps surface and suppress exactly that trap.

ui.comment: Each enabled rule becomes a selectable scan target. The scan runs the chosen rule across the chosen scope (current sector first, whole universe later), and lists every matching stock with its zone band edges, freshness/tier, and the formation date. Bullish rules use the green (--bull) accent, bearish rules the red (--bear) accent, forming rules the amber/early accent — theme-driven tokens, no hardcoded hex.
